_comment: W11.Q1: the dumps scripts/perf/corpus-vault.mjs downloads. None of them is committed. sha256 is null until the owner's first run with --record-pins (the cloud sandbox cannot reach dumps.wikimedia.org or GitHub archives); after that a changed file is refused. To move to a newer dump, change url and file and set sha256 back to null in the same commit.
